14a4b5b6.text:
"The Scythe?" she said in a calm voice.  "Of course I do.  Who here wouldn't?"  She looked at the Riders with steady eyes, and I would have sworn she spoke the truth if I had not known better. There was no way she could know about the Scythe.

Her gambit paid off.  The same Rider who uttered the question before bent his head slightly toward her, and shrieked, "Where?"

"I'll take you.  All of you," she said, and I could see a small hope flicker behind her eyes.
14a4b5b6.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

1cbf64a2.text:
Within just a few days of my visit I found myself tutoring the local children from the nearby farmlands.  The lessons went so well that the town mayor commissioned me to run a school and construction has begun on a brand new schoolhouse!  From Silverpine to Stormwind and now Moonbrook -- who would have guessed I would see so much of Azeroth!

Warm regards,

Stalvan Mistmantle
1cbf64a2.title: A Dusty Unsent Letter

2d549fad.text:
After surviving the flight from Roland's Doom, I hid within a barn owned by a man named Sven.  I spent a few days in the barn, and such horror lingered with me that I never once made myself known to Sven or his family.  But from what I saw from my hiding place, I knew these farmers were quite decent folk.  Had I stepped from my concealment I think they would have taken me in, but trust is hard for me.  Harder still after that shock in the mine.

So I remained hidden.  And it saved my life.
2d549fad.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

34ffd1a9.text:
Sven's wife stood rigid as a board, and her eyes grew wide.  And although her lips pulled back to mouth a scream, no sound escaped.  After a few moments of this torture the hand released her, dropping her to her knees.  The Rider who held the bauble then sat erect in his saddle, and a loud voice erupted from it.

"This woman lies," it said in a voice that has scarred my dreams.  "She has not seen the Scythe."
34ffd1a9.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

3b541535.text:
After the Scythe was freed, a change rippled through the mine.  Light from our flickering torches warped, and the strength of our voices seemed beyond our control.  Sometimes a man's whisper roared through the tunnels forcing hands on ears, and sometimes our shouts barely traveled a few steps before diminishing into a hint on the wind.

Unnerving, yes, but we did not have long to wonder at this strangeness.  It was but a harbinger of what truly drove us from the mine.  The Worgen.
3b541535.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

42d36bd4.text:
To the Honorable Headmaster Crillian,

My former Master, I write to you so that you might know what your apprentice has been doing of late.  Paying heed to your advice, I sought to build my knowledge and wisdom through travel outside the gates of our beloved Stormwind.  My journeys took me to many places but I have decided to take up residence here in the lovely town of Moonbrook.  The surrounding fields of Westfall are most beautiful as the harvest approaches.
42d36bd4.title: A Dusty Unsent Letter

4a138777.text:
After this, the Rider's shoulders stooped slightly, as if a spirit within him had fled.  And then in the old, shrieking voice it used earlier, these final words were uttered:

"The Lord has spoken.  Kill them."
4a138777.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

58805149.text:
"But the way is far, and my children would slow us.  We must leave them."

Her trick was simple, but simple tricks have the best hope of success.  If it worked, it would lead the Riders away from the farm.  She would be lost, but her children would be safe.  And it would work, if only the Riders believed her noble lies.

Although I have never been a student of the Light, I prayed fiercely for Sven's wife as she stood against those terrible Riders.

"Please," I prayed.  "Let them believe."
58805149.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

6d1e2e5d.text:
Or perhaps, I am doomed to witness the change I wrought on Duskwood.  Perhaps it is my fate to watch as the Worgen tear into this land, staining it ever darker with their foulness.

If that truly is my fate, then it is twofold.  For the Worgen are not the only power to clutch at Duskwood - the fiends from Deadwind Pass have also staked claim.

That is the next chapter of my tale, and I pray it is the last...
6d1e2e5d.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

829466b8.text:
But, even though I know I could have done nothing to stop this heinous murder, one true regret does remain: I brought the Black Riders to Sven's farm.  My discovery of the Scythe not only unleashed the Worgen upon Duskwood - it drew the Riders from Deadwind Pass.

I know this because, just before they began their slaughter they asked one question to Sven's wife as she held her children close, giving them what comfort she could though she was certain death was near.
829466b8.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

8508a1be.text:
They stood, frozen, and she met their gazes with calm.  Then one rider looked up, as if hearing a distant call.  He drew from his garb a small gem and peered into it.  He then gestured with the bauble toward Sven's wife.  A light crept from the Rider toward the woman, shaping itself into a grim, white hand.  She stared into the light, unflinching, but I could see uncertainty behind her mask of confidence.  When the hand reached her, it spread its fingers over her head.  

And it squeezed.
8508a1be.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

8c6d16e7.text:
It began with the finding of that cursed scythe in the mine they call Roland's Doom.  Yes, that was the start of it.  Before that, the Defias Brotherhood was happy with our progress in Duskwood.  Before the Scythe, the terrors of this place seemed as tame as Northshire Valley.

But ever since I found the haft of the Scythe jutting from that pile of rubble in the mine and, curse me, pulled it free, Roland's Doom became a place of vile death!
8c6d16e7.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

8db7f755.text:
I spent the next few weeks moving from place to place, never lingering for fear of the Riders.  I am now in the abandoned town of Raven's Hill, as always, hiding.  I cannot face whatever power they used against Sven's wife, and I know it searches Duskwood, even still, for the Scythe.  It is lost to me, and I thank the Light for this, for had I kept it I know I would have been found.  Even now, I know in my heart that I will be found.

I'm so tired.
8db7f755.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

9039f979.text:
I cannot describe what happened next.  It is clear in my mind, but even my wretched soul cannot put to paper the events of those next few, grisly minutes.

I can only write that Sven's family was killed.  And soon after, Sven returned to this grim, deathly scene.  Such grief was in him that I was afraid to show myself.  And so afraid was I that he would find me, I fled from my hiding spot in the barn.  I do not know where Sven is now, but I pray he will, some day, find peace.
9039f979.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

99894f19.text:
I can only guess why I survived that night.  I have always been cautious, always quick to flinch from jabs and leap free of pitfalls.  My nickname, Jitters, comes from this trait.  So perhaps it was just that knack for caution that saved me...

Or maybe it was the Scythe I pulled from the rubble.  It cannot be the Scythe itself, for I lost it during my frantic flight.  But if it was I who brought the Worgen to Duskwood, then perhaps the Worgen afforded me a rare courtesy.  Curse them.
99894f19.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

a1d714d6.text:
If I had known what would happen, I would have cut off my own hand to keep from grasping that rune-carved wood.  So many regrets!  I always thought that was a privilege of the old.  I now know that it is not the old - it is the hopeless - who don the mantle of regret, unable and unwilling to shrug it from shoulders stooped with misery.

But enough waxing like a pipe-mad poet.  I must continue with the chronicle...
a1d714d6.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

a415f7ac.text:
I never learned the name of Sven's wife, as she was only ever called "dearest," and "my love," and "mommy" by her husband and children.  But I wish I knew it.  I am the only living memory of her deed that day, and although she was just a farmer's wife, never have I seen a man or woman act with such bravery.

Of course she did not know of the Scythe, but when she learned the Riders sought it, in an instant a plan formed in her head.

And it was bold and clever.  If only it had worked.
a415f7ac.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

b16fe85e.text:
My Journal

The terror of these past few weeks is almost more than I can bear; why is it that by writing words into this book I can somehow keep the madness at bay?  Perhaps it is as if I'm confessing my sins to a silent companion, or freeing my mind of these tortured thoughts and confining them to paper.  

I began a journal before this one, but it remains in a place to which I cannot return.  So I will start afresh.  But this time, I will start from the true beginning.
b16fe85e.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

b324379d.text:
A few days after I arrived at the barn, Sven left his farm for Darkshire.  He kissed his wife and smiled to his children and promised to return soon with toys and sweets.  The poor man.  That was the last time he saw his family unmutilated.  

At least they parted happily.  And at least his wife was the first to die, and was freed from seeing the slaughter of her children.  But these small graces do nothing for me.  I saw what happened, and it will ever haunt my dreams.
b324379d.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

c6e293f3.text:
They came at us from everywhere, clawing from hidden holes at our feet and dropping upon us from silent perches above.  Half our men fell in those first panicked minutes.  The rest, including myself, tried to flee.  As I ran I saw so many of my brothers taken by tooth and claw, heard so many screams cut short or gurgle to silence.

For all I know, I am the only $r to escape that place.
c6e293f3.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

eac9523e.text:
"The Scythe of Elune." one of the Riders shrieked in a voice both harsh and shrill, like the grinding of an axe on stone.  And the last word - Elune - it croaked, as if choking on the sound.

Dread gripped me when I heard that voice, both from the horrid sound of it, and because...I knew the Scythe of which the Rider spoke.  It must be the same cursed thing I drew from the rocks of Roland's Doom days before.  It was what the Black Riders sought!

And it was what would kill Sven's family.
eac9523e.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

f3d1bc03.text: My hand trembles as I recall the details of that night, when Sven was away and his family was doomed to face the Black Riders alone.  Again regret claws at me, for I was there and could have risen against those fiends from Deadwind Pass.  But it is a false regret.  It is the same that plagues any survivor of a tragedy.  I know that, had I left my place of hiding I too would have been killed, my body ripped and torn, and its pieces spread so widely that I would not be recognized.
f3d1bc03.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

2198|dc8290dc.name: Crier Goodman
2198|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

2327|5305ac4b.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|5305ac4b.text: Yes my son? What can I assist you with?

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

267226|9fad5d95.name: Grey Riding Kodo
267226|9fad5d95.text: <The kodo lets out a happy grunt as you approach.>

267330|0371bf6f.name: Nawka Wildsong
267330|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

268|130446c3.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|130446c3.text:
I don't know if I should chalk it up to her reclusive nature, but I don't seem to have anything on Ira Valor.

Asking around town, I didn't hear much about any mysterious rescues in the forest. One merchant seemed to think he saw a woman in the forest at some point, but that is entirely too vague to use as evidence.

268|1a2624af.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|1a2624af.text:
Silvia Valor was one of the few names I recognized. Though, not quite the hero the book you found spoke of.

She did indeed protect farmlands throughout the town, but often against the wishes of the farmers themselves! Anyone who so much as looked like they didn't belong was chased out of town by the tip of a sword. Curious.

268|cfd22992.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|cfd22992.text:
Citizens are reporting attacks throughout the forest by phantoms. Normally, I would ignore such ghost stories, but not in Darkshire. Whatever the Valor family was in life, they've become as dangerous as any other monster in these woods in death.

Something has corrupted these souls. We need to put them to rest.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

2981|72360bcb.name: Chief Hawkwind
2981|72360bcb.text: Hail, $c. In my years I have seen many eager $r who wish to prove their worth to the tribe. It should not be forgotten that eagerness is no substitute for wisdom and experience.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3060|d1e27715.name: Gart Mistrunner
3060|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

3062|996eca9b.name: Meela Dawnstrider
3062|996eca9b.text: May the spirits be with you.

3065|2d23ed1c.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|2d23ed1c.text: I do not have the knowledge you seek.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

3690|98522534.name: Kar Stormsinger
3690|98522534.text: I can teach you the finer points of Kodo Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

392|9183bb21.name: Captain Grayson
392|9183bb21.text: Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

133-progress.name: Abercrombie
133-progress.text: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick!  Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
133-progress.title: Ghoulish Effigy

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

159-progress.name: Abercrombie
159-progress.text: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
159-progress.title: Juice Delivery

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

262-progress.name: Madame Eva
262-progress.text: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it.  I may be able to divine something of its owner.
262-progress.title: The Shadowy Figure

265-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
265-progress.text:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
265-progress.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

266-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-progress.text:
The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
266-progress.title: Inquire at the Inn

268-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
268-progress.text: Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
268-progress.title: Return to Sven

3094-progress.name: Gart Mistrunner
3094-progress.text: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' spirits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever be your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.
3094-progress.title: Verdant Note

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

453-progress.name: Jitters
453-progress.text: Who are you??  Leave me be!
453-progress.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

68-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
68-progress.text: Ah, I remember you.  You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow.  Did you ever find what you were looking for?
68-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

79363-accept.name: Unknown
79363-accept.text:
A sword left by the spirit of Raven Hill's guard, Silvia Valor, who lived her life protecting civilians and their homes.

With Silvia's spirit still visiting farmsteads, perhaps her unfinished business was to route the defias who have taken up residence in Addle's Stead south of Raven Hill.
79363-accept.title: Silvia's Sword

79363-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
79363-complete.text:
Silvia Valor, hmm? Ah, yes. A fine warrior and a defender of our way of life--albeit with a narrow vision of what that was.

Your guess is as good as mine what she would want, but the defias was a good start. Let me study this blade further.
79363-complete.title: Silvia's Sword

79363-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
79363-progress.text: You look like you've seen a ghost!
79363-progress.title: Silvia's Sword

94-progress.name: Unknown
94-progress.text:
This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.

There is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...
94-progress.title: A Watchful Eye

95805-progress.name: Seer Graytongue
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

96659-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659-progress.title: The Adventurer
